title: Origin story: Arjuna
description: Arjuna was the third Pandava prince, son of Indra, trained by Drona to be the world's greatest archer. On Kurukshetra's field, faced with killing his own kin, he despaired — until Krishna, his charioteer, delivered the Bhagavad Gita, teaching him to act without attachment to results.
